summary: Iteration 4 QA regression pass for Trace (formerly Loom) with REAL TMDB now active. PRIMARY BUG FIX VERIFIED: onboarding 'Dimensions is not defined' crash is fully resolved — from Login → Create account (login-goto-register) loads onboarding-screen without any red-box, all 5 slides (welcome/share/sources/ai/lists) render via index-driven state, onboarding-next advances slide-by-slide, onboarding-dot-<i> jumps, onboarding-skip and final 'Get Started' both navigate to register, onboarding-goto-login returns to login. Zero pageerrors and zero 'is not defined' errors captured across every flow tested. Backend: 15/15 iteration-3 pytest tests still pass in 26.7s against the deployed EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (auth + auto-save + library filters/sort + collections multi-select/batch + search). Full E2E frontend flow on 390×844 mobile viewport (Expo web): register (@gmail.com) → home-screen; add-discovery text 'Interstellar (2014) and Arrival (2016)' → add-saved-banner 'Auto-saved 2 title(s)…' + app-toast 'Saved to library: Interstellar, Arrival' + both detection cards show '✓ In your library'; Library populates with REAL TMDB posters for Interstellar + Arrival; opening Arrival shows movie-detail-screen with real backdrop/poster, MOVIE · 2016, ★7.6, 116m, director Denis Villeneuve, full cast, genres (Drama/Sci-Fi/Mystery), 'Where to watch' with providers (Apple TV, Paramount+, Paramount+ Essential), detail-play-trailer visible; Lists → Create New List (lists-create-button) opens list-new-screen with 2 selectable library items (list-select-<id>), name + multi-select + list-new-submit → navigates to /list/col_… showing both posters + 'Add titles from library' which re-opens list-new-screen in add mode; Search screen renders with search-input + suggestion chips + search-submit; profile-logout-button logs out, then login-email/password/submit lands back on home-screen. TMDB enrichment (posters, ratings, runtime, director, cast, genres, watch providers, trailers) is fully functional now with the valid 32-hex TMDB_API_KEY. Deprecated ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images from prior iteration is still present but not blocking any tested flow.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated `ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images` is still used. In expo-image-picker v16+/17+ this enum is removed — pass `mediaTypes: ['images']` (or the string 'images') instead. Reference: /app/frontend/app/add-discovery.tsx:41 (carried over from iteration 3, not tested-blocking).
Console emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warnings — cosmetic on web preview only.

action_items: None blocking. (Carry-over) Replace `ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images` with `mediaTypes: ['images']` in /app/frontend/app/add-discovery.tsx:41 to future-proof against expo-image-picker v16+ removal.
(Optional cleanup) Migrate shadow*/props.pointerEvents to style equivalents to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.tsx refactor is clean — index-driven state, no FlatList/Dimensions imports, all interactive elements have testIDs. Safe-area handled via useSafeAreaInsets. No issues.
server.py still ~800 lines; recommend router split (auth/discoveries/library/collections/search) before adding more endpoints (carry-over).

add-discovery still has a per-detection manual save button behind a candidate flow — unreachable for confidence≥0.5 auto-saves (they show 'In your library' badge). Consider removing entirely to reduce surface area (carry-over).
list/new.tsx dual-purpose (create + add-titles) via ?listId= param works well but doubles route responsibility.

rca_of_issue: Primary Dimensions crash RCA: previous onboarding.tsx had removed the FlatList + Dimensions imports mid-refactor but still referenced them in the render tree, throwing 'Dimensions is not defined' at first render. Current implementation (verified) uses only `useState<number>(0)` for slide index and renders `SLIDES[index]` — no Dimensions/FlatList anywhere. Verified by 0 pageerrors + 0 'is not defined' console errors + successful navigation across all 5 slides + dot jumps + skip + goto-login + Get Started.
